evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and alters ArgsManager in src/common/args.{cpp,h}.
rationale: Prevents subtle configuration and security bugs where negated ALLOW_LIST options like `-norpcwhitelist` return true on `IsArgSet()` and are mistakenly treated as enabled with empty lists. Fixing this API footgun across the codebase provides substantial and durable correctness improvements to argument handling.
